text: What was the Bank of Japan's policy rate at the end of 2024, and how did it compare with the ECB's?
The tool description shows one code per dimension. Nothing says several can be asked for at once, so the obvious route is one call per country.
Trying SDMX's own OR syntax, which I know from the source rather than from any tool description.
ANSWERED. BoJ 0.25, euro area 3.0, both per cent per year, Dec 2024.

FINDING: nothing in fetch_data's description says a dimension can take several codes. One call answered both countries once I used SDMX's + syntax, which I only knew from the source. An agent follows the example in the docstring and pays for one download per country.

FINDING: the first BIS fetch printed sdmx1's parse diagnostics to STDOUT, including the whole raw DataSet XML. Survived 2>/dev/null, so it is stdout and not stderr. The README claims the MCP SDK diverts that descriptor. Nothing tests the claim, and if it is wrong the JSON-RPC stream is corrupted mid-session on the provider the README leads with.
